items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’d like to know if I can go and see him, because we’re old friends. We go back a long time.

ctx.x: I listened to that the other day.

I’m trying to get in touch with the estate of Rod McKuen to get that tape. But I think something’s happening, because I call Rod’s office, and the lady gives me the same answer every time. I give them the message, and I never get a call back. So I’m not sure what is going on. If I’m in Los Angeles long enough I’m going to make a personal trip down to the office, and I’m going to demand to know what is happening, because he may be ill. If he is, I’d like to know that, and I’d like to know if I can go and see him,…
Jon, what are your thoughts about jazz as an American national treasure and the whole arts environment and its impact upon American society?
